title: Fullstack Developer
description: Nordbridge is looking for a fullstack developer to help build and maintain our customer-facing web platform. You'll work across a Node/Express API and a React frontend, with a PostgreSQL database underneath. We ship fast and expect comfort moving between frontend and backend code in the same day.
requirements: 3+ years building web applications with TypeScript
Hands-on experience with Node.js/Express on the backend
Hands-on experience with React on the frontend
Comfortable with Docker for local development and CI
Experience with GitHub Actions or similar CI/CD tooling
